label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
**Please read and pass on: I'm safe, what I need, and a warning about a fake fund**

Dear friends, neighbours, Little Acorns families, and anyone who's had this forwarded to them,

I'm okay. Marmalade is okay. We're staying with my sister in Rondebosch and we're safe.

My phone has been going mad since Saturday night and I just can't answer everyone one by one. I'm so tired. So I'm putting it all in one letter, and please send it on to anyone who's been asking.

One thing first, because it involves your money. The only fundraiser for me is the BackaBuddy page my friend Zinhle set up: backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court. There's a fake one going around, and I explain that further down.

**What happened**

This is the short version, because I don't want to relive it all.

A fire started at about 11:40pm on Saturday 7 November in a ground floor flat at Lindale Court, on Station Road in Obs. I'm on the second floor, in flat 12. Everyone in all 14 flats got out. Two people were treated for smoke at Groote Schuur and sent home.

I only woke up because our neighbour, Uncle Faizel, was banging on every door on our floor in his vest and slippers. I grabbed my phone and my cat and nothing else. Marmalade then hid under a car for two hours, which seemed fair enough.

The fire department says it was probably an electrical fault, but they're still investigating, so I'm not going to guess.

My flat is basically gone. There's smoke and water everywhere and the ceiling came down in the lounge. The landlord says nobody will be back in for at least six weeks. Furniture can be replaced. Marmalade can't.

**The fundraiser, and the one that isn't ours**

I hate asking for help and I feel weird about a fundraiser. Zinhle told me to shut up and accept it, so I'm doing what I'm told.

The real page is backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court. The target is R25 000 and last time I looked it was already at R11 400, which I can't quite get my head around.

People keep sending me a different "fund". There's a page called "Thandi Fire Relief" on another site, and a WhatsApp message asking people to EFT money to a Capitec account. That is not me, it's not Zinhle, and it's not anyone I know. I've reported it.

If you get that message, please don't pay and don't forward it. If you've already passed it on, please let those people know. If it isn't the BackaBuddy link above, it isn't mine.

**What I need**

- Help with the deposit for a new place. This is the big one.
- Shoes and clothes I can wear to school. I'm a size 6 shoe and a size 34.
- A laptop, if anyone has an old one that still works. All my lesson planning was on mine.

**What I don't need**

- More clothes in general. I already have too many, and I'll pass the extras on to the other flats.
- Food. My sister's freezer is full.

Please don't think I'm ungrateful for what's already arrived. One of my Ladybirds' moms left a bag of clothes on my sister's gate at 7am on Sunday without even knocking. You know who you are, and I cried.

**For the Ladybirds parents**

The concert on 27 November is still happening. Please don't worry.

Everything I took home to laminate was in the flat, so the 22 crowns and the children's handprint banner are gone. The Ladybirds will have crowns on the day. I promise.

I'm back at school on Wednesday. Please don't make a big thing of it in front of the kids. They're four and five, and I'd love it to be an ordinary morning for them.

**If I don't reply**

I'm reading everything. I've been crying at every message, in a good way. I'll get to comments slowly, and please don't be offended if I don't answer your DM. It isn't you. There's one of me and a lot of you, which is a nice problem to have.

**Thank you**

Thank you, Uncle Faizel, for waking up a whole floor. Thank you, Zinhle, for not listening to me. Thank you to my sister for taking in one sister and one very offended cat. Thank you to everyone who has messaged, donated, dropped things off or just asked after us. People have been amazing and I'm so grateful.

With love,
Thandi (and Marmalade)

---

Two things to check before you send it:

- **Wednesday:** once this gets forwarded, "Wednesday" could mean any week, so add the date.
- **Where offers go:** the letter asks for shoes, work clothes and a laptop but doesn't say who to contact or where to drop them. Since you're not answering DMs, add a line naming a contact person and how to reach them.

It's about 800 words, the short end of your range, so it survives being read on a phone.
